reason: Conversation 2 quickly reached the correct diagnosis (overloading beyond the 6kg dry capacity plus reduced spin), suggested a half-load with full spin test, and concluded with no fault, no part and no escalation. Conversation 1 correctly noted the heater works and that 9kg exceeds capacity, but then dragged the homeowner through repeated unplugging, pump-filter and condenser hunting. It also gave inaccurate guidance that the condenser is reachable behind the filter flap, and it ignored the customer's half-drum-dries-fine result, which already confirmed overloading.
